_generated: generated by running both baseline routers as sealed programs on this board under a generous routing budget (up to 500 passes and a 300 s wall-clock budget per run; reference A given 8 worker threads, reference B allowed up to 30 stagnant passes) and measuring the resulting Layout under the spec's connectivity and DRC rules; the best (lowest incomplete-after with no added violation) of the runs is reported per reference

budget.runsPerReference: reference A up to 2 (its parallel search varies between runs; the lowest incomplete-after is reported); reference B 1 (its search is deterministic)

notes: The board carries 25 pre-existing different-net Violations from hand-matched differential pairs; both references preserve them and add none (violationsAfter equals violationsBefore). Reference B joins every attempted net and leaves 1 incomplete under the spec's counting; reference A leaves 4. The `routing-slow-cm5-carrier-complete` bound (at most 2 incomplete) is reached by reference B (and bettered to 1) under this budget. traceLengthMm is each reference's own reported routed-copper length in millimetres; the two references report on different length scales on some boards (a units-resolution difference), so the two are not directly comparable, and the figure is advisory.
